description: Wait for mail to arrive in an inbox: answers as soon as there is any newer than `since` (a time or a message id; default now), or after `timeout` seconds (at most 50). Pass `next_since` back to wait for the next.

body.description: `clean` (the default) serves the Firewall’s cleaned text: what a person cannot see is taken out. `original` is the message as it arrived.

name: await_message
title: Wait for mail
